name: Sonohara Yuri
source:
A first year student and member of the space research club. She is a positive and cheerful girl with an interest in yuri. She calls Fuyuki "onee-sama" and adores her.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
